描述_EN: jar of porcelain, painted in red, green and yellow. the neck is painted with fret pattern. the body is divided into three horizontal zones. of bulbous form with flat base and short wide neck. the middle zone is filled in with lotus flowers of another form and foliage on a continuous wavy stem, the lower with formal panelling. the uppermost is painted with lotus flowers placed alternately on either side of a chevron band.
描述_ZN: 瓷器罐，红、绿、黄三色彩绘。 颈部绘有浮雕图案。 器身分为三个横向区域。 为球状，平底，短宽颈。 中间的区域是另一种形式的莲花和连续的波浪形茎上的叶子，下面的区域是正式的镶板。 最上层绘有莲花，交替放置在雪佛龙带的两侧。
